notes.title: December Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9117305/0ca067c792c6cebb3ecb735964650c9eda7205e6.jpg[/img]

Ahnayro owners will now unlock an exclusive new skin in NITE Team 4. This skin automatically unlocks if you have Ahnayro in your steam library.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/5878712ad8e8bbd0b377dc811ca11524ed19ba0d.gif[/img]

NITE Team 4 is the hacking and cyber warfare extension of The Black Watchmen universe, including training center for new players with no past knowledge of hacking, a new mission campaign in the universe of Black Watchmen, hourly and daily bounties, players created servers, open world missions and sets of online investigation and puzzles.

You can get NT4 on sales right now here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/544390/NITE_Team_4/

notes.title: FULL RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/8cdce2c59ca24d17f532b945772adb40b50abbcf.jpg[/img]

 
[b]Dreamers, it’s finally here![/b]
Enter the dream world of Ahnayro, where shadowy figures, terror, and the only possibility of salvation all lurk. Strange presences weave in and out of your mind as you journey into the darkest shadows of your dreams. Confront inner demons and lurking evils as you seek the truth, a truth found in between two worlds: the waking and the dreaming.


We’ve worked hard for over a year now on adding the complete depth and complexity that the dream world Ahnayro deserves. The dream fragment riddles act as rabbit holes, inviting you deeper into the mysteries of the dream world, while the narrative, soundtrack, and images act as breadcrumbs, showing you that you’re on the right path as you progress along your investigation.


We have made changes to Table 1 and Table 2 to deepen the immersion and to further connect the complexity of the puzzles with the overarching narrative. Join the dreamer as she navigates her dreams and tries to save herself from her own inner turmoil and illness.


As before, don’t forget to [url=https://forums.aliceandsmith.com/]visit us on the forums[/url] to meet your fellow oneironauts and to discuss what you see beyond the veil of reality.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/449730/

notes.title: Dev Update #001
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First of all, a big thank you for all your feedback, we are very excited after this weekend's launch! Today we pushed some bug fixes on the production server:

Ahnayro Patch Notes:
[list]
    [*]Made the whole screen clickable to continue on tutorial and table intro/outro texts 
    [*]Fixed dynamic font display during tutorial
    [*]Better support for smaller resolutions and displays
    [*]Replay button added for table intros
    [*]Grammar correction on intro text to table 1
[/list]

Don't forget to visit us on the [url=http://forums.ahnayro.com/]forums[/url]. We are a really welcoming community and would love to hear you!
